en: Improved `/claude-api`: `hillclimb` no longer spends rounds on prompt rewordings too small for the eval to measure, and an extra page you ask for beside `report.html` is built as one local file that loads nothing from the network
zh: 改进 `/claude-api`：`hillclimb` 不再把轮次花在 eval 无法衡量的 prompt 措辞微调上；在 `report.html` 旁额外请求的页面会构建为单个本地文件，不从网络加载任何内容
